summary: Short kerb at a main-road junction mouth, hemmed in by dense shrubs.
reasons: Junction mouth, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Park and trees on the east side, apartments 27 m or more across the road, but the spot is exposed at the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane bends into the main road; shrubs and trees press on the kerb, leaving no room to stop clear of the lane or the junction.
drivers.traffic: Turning traffic from the main road, directly at the junction.
drivers.convention: One car parks further south along the kerb, none at this end.

flags: Within about 10 m of the main-road junction
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the whole stretch.
